request:
Create an enemy-mob-32 sprite named "Red Scarf Cutpurse".

Creative brief
Name: Red Scarf Cutpurse
Collection: Ironroad Marauders. Organized highway raiders who turn practical medieval weapons, shields, traps, chains, and stolen supplies into disciplined projectile patterns.
Core concept: A fast flanker that throws knives while crossing behind the player.
Body and silhouette: Small agile humanoid with a short cloak, narrow shoulders, bent knees, and a dagger in each hand.
Signature features: Long red scarf, dark eye mask, and several visible throwing knives.
Palette and materials: Dusty brown, dark charcoal, muted red, and worn steel.
Movement personality: Cocky, nimble, and evasive.
Attack concept: Dashes sideways and throws three knives backward across the route it just traveled.
Directional details: The scarf knot and trailing cloth sit over the left shoulder.
Avoid: Ninja costume, ornate assassin armor, knives too small to distinguish.
